zones.title: Find the appointment
zones.body: An unverified session (no PIN yet) is refused. DealerBook bookings by the session's customer id and chassis number, status booked; a spoken reference code narrows. Exactly one match becomes the appointment in hand on the session, with its offer id for the slot search.

panels.title: AR-24 FindAppointment
panels.body: Lookup keys of the endpoint sheet (2026-10-23): customerId, chassisNumber, offerId, status. The session's customer and vehicle are the keys; a spoken reference code only narrows. Exactly one booked appointment becomes the appointment in hand (DealerBook booking id, offer id, dealer); several are listed for the caller to choose from.
